title: Keep listeners interested
subtitle: 「讓聽眾保持興趣／抓住觀眾注意力／讓人想繼續聽」，究竟是哪一種？
description: 「讓聽眾保持興趣／抓住觀眾注意力／讓人想繼續聽」，究竟是哪一種？

words.meaning: 抓住聽眾注意力；維持觀眾專注
words.note: 最直接、最自然的改寫之一，強調讓觀眾持續專注，不分心。
words.example: A strong opening can hold audience attention from the start.

exercises.original: The speaker changed pace and used examples to keep listeners interested throughout the forty-minute talk.
exercises.zh: 講者改變語速並使用例子，讓聽眾在四十分鐘演講中一直保持專注。
exercises.upgrade: hold audience attention · 抓住聽眾注意力；維持觀眾專注

options.explanation: throughout the forty-minute talk 是持續注意力線索；hold audience attention 比單純開場吸引更精確。
強調聽眾心理投入、參與或反應，不只是保持專注。 本題的決定性線索集中在另一種注意力／參與方式，因此不如 hold audience attention 精確。
較正式，強調興趣持續不下降。 本題的決定性線索集中在另一種注意力／參與方式，因此不如 hold audience attention 精確。

強調集中注意、防止分心，未必表示內容特別有趣。 本題的決定性線索集中在另一種注意力／參與方式，因此不如 hold audience attention 精確。

falseSynonyms.zh: entertain 重點是讓人覺得有趣、愉快；要維持注意力不一定需要娛樂性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A joke may entertain the audience. A clear structure can keep listeners interested without being humorous.

falseSynonyms.zh: inform 是提供資訊，不保證聽眾會一直投入。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The talk informed listeners about the new rules. Stories helped keep listeners interested throughout the talk.

falseSynonyms.zh: persuade 是改變觀點或促使行動；維持興趣只是傳達效果的一部分。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The speaker tried to persuade voters. The speaker varied her examples to keep listeners interested.

falseSynonyms.zh: capture attention 偏向把注意力吸引過來的那一刻；keep listeners interested 更強調持續。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The opening image captured attention. The speaker then used stories to keep listeners interested.

falseSynonyms.zh: engage listeners 很接近，但通常包含更深的心理參與、反應或互動，不只是被動注意。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The questions engaged listeners in the topic. The varied pacing kept listeners interested.

falseSynonyms.word: keep listeners interested / keep listeners focused
falseSynonyms.zh: focused 側重集中注意、防止分心；interested 側重覺得內容有吸引力。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The diagram kept listeners focused on the process. The anecdote kept listeners interested in the topic.

falseSynonyms.word: keep listeners interested / hold the floor
falseSynonyms.zh: hold the floor 表示持續佔有發言權，不等於成功吸引聽眾。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He held the floor for twenty minutes. She held the audience's attention for twenty minutes.

falseSynonyms.zh: interest 可作名詞／動詞；interesting 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The story aroused interest. The story was interesting.
